item.title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
item.description:
📝 GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension By Sergiu Gatlan May 20, 2026 04:14 AM 0 GitHub has confirmed that roughly 3,800 internal repositories were breached after one of its employees installed a malicious VS Code extension. TeamPCP GitHub breach claims (Matthew Maynard) VS Code extensions are plugins that can be installed from the VS Code Marketplace (the official store for add-ons for Microsoft's code editor) to add features or integrate tools into the editor. Download Now Related Articles: GitHub investigates internal repositories breach claimed by TeamPCPGrafana breach caused by missed token rotation after TanStack attack7-Eleven confirms data breach claimed by the ShinyHunters gangGrafana says stolen GitHub token let hackers steal codebaseTeamPCP hackers advertise Mistral AI code repos for sale.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/github-confirms-breach-of-3-800-repos-via-malicious-vscode-extension/
